_source: Git-tracked fallback for curia-research-daily and curia-suggestion-review's daily briefing (see docs/data/pending-review-queue.json's own note for the full diagnosis — the Artifact tool's write_db is unreachable from this job's headless execution environment, read_db is fine). Each run appends one entry here instead of writing directly to Curia Command's `briefings` collection; synced in from a human or an interactive session during a normal check-in. `synced` flips to true once it's landed in the portal.

entries.title: 18 venues + Lymm and Ramsbottom (new districts) promoted; 1 rejected as closed, 1 sent for review, 1 closure-audit note
entries.summary: Independently re-verified all 20 pending candidates in venue-suggestions.json (suggestedDates 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-24) and both pending district-suggestions.json candidates, promoting 18 venues across Chester, Macclesfield, Heaton Moor, Stockport (Underbanks), Cheadle Hulme, Deansgate, Didsbury, Chinatown, Bramhall, Northern Quarter, Ancoats and Mobberley, plus Lymm and Ramsbottom as new districts. Little Tap (Tarporley) was rejected — it and its sister site closed permanently 22 June 2026, reversing the original candidate's 'still trading' framing. Coco Tang (Spinningfields) is real and credible but not yet confirmed as actually trading despite its announced autumn 2026 opening — sent to pending-review-queue.json rather than guessed either way. Curia Command's pending_review collection had zero decided items to apply this run. The closure-audit rotating slice found 4 of 5 still trading cleanly; Northwich Market shows a real partial-decline signal (not a closure) — sent to pending-review-queue.json as a note for a human rather than a removal proposal.

entries.title: Research-tool outage limited today's pass to 3 promotions; 11 items left pending, untouched
entries.summary: A genuine research-tool outage hit for most of this run — WebSearch mostly returned 'unavailable' errors or surfaced only Wikipedia-indexed content, and WebFetch was blocked (EGRESS_BLOCKED) for essentially every other domain tried (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Instagram, Facebook, Tripadvisor, Companies House, CAMRA/whatpub, even plain Wikipedia). Only 3 of the 10 new pending candidates (all in the Chester district) had enough Wikipedia coverage to be genuinely independently re-verified and were promoted: Storyhouse, Chester Cathedral, Grosvenor Museum. The other 7 new candidates (6 in Chester plus Eden in Heaton Moor), all 4 long-stuck pending-review-queue items (Prana, Buon Cibo, Rustik, the Underbank naming mix-up), and today's closure-audit slice could not be honestly verified one way or the other, so nothing was promoted, rejected, or newly queued for any of them — they remain exactly as they were, pending a re-run once tooling recovers. Curia Command's pending_review collection was checked via read_db (unaffected by the outage) and had zero decided items to apply.
